description: This file is a plugin source for CKEditor, specifically the 'wysiwygarea' plugin, which manages the main editing area in WYSIWYG mode. It includes functions for inserting HTML, elements, handling focus, and managing the iframe that hosts the editable document.

methods.name: nonExitable
methods.description: Checks if an element is in the list of non-exitable elements like table or pre.

methods.name: checkReadOnly
methods.description: Determines if the current selection is read-only.

methods.name: onInsert
methods.description: Wraps insert functions to handle focus and snapshot saving during insertion.

methods.name: doInsertHtml
methods.description: Inserts HTML content into the editor, handling browser-specific behaviors.

methods.name: doInsertText
methods.description: Inserts plain text into the editor, converting whitespace and handling formatting.

methods.name: doInsertElement
methods.description: Inserts a DOM element into the editor at the current selection.

methods.name: restoreDirty
methods.description: Resets the editor's dirty state if it is not already dirty.

methods.name: isNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a node is not whitespace or a bookmark.

methods.name: isNbsp
methods.description: Checks if a node is a non-breaking space.

methods.name: restoreSelection
methods.description: Unlocks and re-locks the selection if it is locked.

methods.name: isBlankParagraph
methods.description: Checks if a block element is a blank paragraph.

methods.name: activateEditing
methods.description: Activates the editing mode in an empty document by simulating key events.

methods.name: onSelectionChangeFixBody
methods.description: Fixes document structure issues on selection change, wrapping content in paragraphs or divs as needed.
